sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:109512
Court No. - 50
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 475 of 2023
Applicant :- Momeen
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This Application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant, with a prayer to direct the court below to hear and decide the Case No. 6605 of 2022, under Sections 26 (2)(i),
3(1)(zz)(iv)(v), 31(2), 26(2)(v)/59(i), 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Police Station- Bhojpur, District Ghaziabad, pending before learned ACJM, First, Ghaziabad expeditiously within a st On perusal of record, it appears that the complaint was filed on 22.7.2022 by competent officer.
The accused appeared and was enlarged on bail on 6.9.2022.
Presently, the case is fixed for evidence.

Considering the fact that the trial is pending since 2022, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no legal impediment.
Momeen vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 May, 2023
